subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part of the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

As the rulers of the planet, humans like to think that __it is the largest creatures__ that will emerge victorious from the struggle for survival.

options.text: it is the most large creatures

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **they are the largest creatures**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"it is the largest creatures"** is grammatically incorrect and does not agree with the plural subject "humans". (यह सबसे बड़े प्राणी हैं)

 
 
• **Example: **It is the largest creatures that dominate the food chain.
 
 
 
• **"They are the largest creatures" **correctly uses the plural pronoun "they" to refer back to "humans" and maintains subject-verb agreement. (वे सबसे बड़े प्राणी हैं)
 
 
• **Example: **They are the largest creatures that can survive in the harshest environments.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct substitution for the given phrase is **'they are the largest creatures'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **they are the largest creatures**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **No substitution** (कोई प्रतिस्थापन नहीं): This option implies that the original phrase is correct, which it is not in this context.

 
 
• **Example:** As the rulers of the planet, humans like to think that it is the largest creatures that will emerge victorious from the struggle for survival. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **It is the most large creatures** (यह सबसे बड़े प्राणी हैं): The phrase "most large" is not grammatically correct; "largest" should be used instead.
 
 
• **Example:** It is the most large creatures that dominate the ecosystem. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **They are a largest creature** (वे एक सबसे बड़े प्राणी हैं): This option incorrectly uses "a" with "largest" which is a superlative adjective and should be used with "the".
 
 
• **Example:** They are a largest creature in the ocean. (Incorrect)
